entities.summary: Luciana de Andrade is a Brazilian singer, songwriter and actress. In 2002 she won the talent show Popstars and joined the Brazilian girl group Rouge, recording two of the four studio albums, Rouge (2002) and C'est La Vie (2003). With over 6 million records sold, the Rouge are the best-selling Brazilian female group of all time. In 2004 she left the band citing exhaustion and creative differences, but rejoined when they reunited for a fifth studio album, Les 5inq (2019) and concert tour: 15 Anos Tour (2018).
